name: Notification System Dispatch Web Push
description: A 'webpush' dispatcher plugin for notification_system_dispatch: sends browser Web Push (VAPID, via web_push_api) and Safari/Apple Push notifications for a user's notifications. Adds an apple_registration entity, a user-token table, a service worker route, an opt-in popup block, and an Apple Web Service endpoint set.
project_description: The web-push channel for notification_system_dispatch. It registers a 'webpush' notification_system_dispatcher plugin that renders a user's notifications through admin-configured Twig templates and sends them (a) to browser Web Push subscriptions via the web_push_api module using a VAPID key pair, and (b) to Safari/macOS via Apple Push using a .p12 certificate. It ships a WebPushClient and AppleWebPushClient service, an apple_registration content entity plus a per-user token table, a service-worker route, an opt-in popup block and a user-settings integration, and an Apple Web Service endpoint set (push package, device registration/delete, user token, log). Requires the web_push_api contrib module. VAPID keys and the Apple certificate password are stored in module configuration.
